newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Wild animals kill 115 Tanzanians, injure 135.
newsitem.headline: Wild animals kill 115 Tanzanians, injure 135.

text.p: Wild animals in Tanzania killed 115 residents in a year and injured 135, according to a senior government official.

Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism Zakia Meghji told parliament in Dodoma, central Tanzania, on Friday wild animals killed 285 cows, 316 goats, 155 sheep and 133 other domestic animals in the 1996/97 financial year.
The deaths marked a sharp increase on the previous year because drought forced animals to encroach onto agricultural and village land, Meghji said.
